content.nextStage: QRY-BOUNDARY after QRY-01 completion and root source checkpoint; QRY-02 held on DOM-02.
content.sourceCustody: Existing source, code, semantic, data and native owners unchanged. Root relays approved scope; not an actual direct user answer or native authentication.

writeOwnership.laterBoundary: Root approves Education-owned neutral leaf extraction described in exact DOM-01 query-boundary.ts, preserving old exports/function bodies and every actual edge. DOM worker is parked, so reserved constant/type extraction is serialized before DOM-02. No business rule changes in QRY-BOUNDARY.
writeOwnership.sharedGit: Root performs staging/local commits of exact owned paths with its authorized tools. SubLead authors and verifies source, requests a source checkpoint via its result, and does not request native Git approval/bypass. Native permissions/config remain with native runtime.

content.recordLayout: Raw logs/check receipts belong under architecture/academy-query-integration/observations, never arbitrary checks/ or other non-record directories inside canonical work/<project>/<work>. Existing Inputs remain immutable; corrected results use new IDs.
content.resultContract: Separate immutable result Input and Verification Input, actual taskVerificationTarget, observation Evidence reference and exact result Input sha256. Use existing canonical APIs; no separate validator framework. Canonical committed snapshot and transition will be checked by root before dependent dispatch.
content.resourceBudget: Root plus one active subLead; one heavy check; no other panes/agents initially.
